title: Velvet Decay
description: A woman in a red velvet suit sits slumped in a director's chair in a ruined outdoor theater, green toxic smoke rising from her body and a large decaying movie screen behind her. An open book with glowing pink imagery, film reels, and scattered photographs lie at her feet under a dramatic apocalyptic sky.
prompt: A woman wearing a red velvet suit and gold gloves sits exhausted in a director's chair in the middle of a ruined outdoor cinema, green toxic smoke rising from her body and the massive decaying movie screen behind her which shows a ballerina, a cowboy, and a hazmat figure. An open book emitting pink glowing light, film reels and old photographs are scattered on the ground in front of her, destroyed city skyline in the background under a fiery orange and purple sky, cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital painting
